defs.def: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc. 邮政；邮递系统

ex.s: ■Mail your entry to us by October 31 this year.
ex.t: ■在今年10月31日前将你的参赛作品邮寄给我们。

defs.def: letters, packages, etc. that are sent and delivered 邮件；信件；邮包

ex.s: They sent a mail to their neighbors.
They sent a mail to their neighbors.

defs.def: messages that are sent or received on a computer 电子邮件；电邮

ex.s: It took about two weeks to arrive, and it was a bit damaged, but it was so nice to get some sweets and jam from home; I’ve been dying to have some of my favourite sweets, and it’s always nice to get mail!
ex.t: 包裹大约两周才到，虽然有点损坏，但能从家里收到糖果和果酱真是太好了；我一直非常想吃一些我最喜欢的糖果，而且收到邮件总是很棒！

ex.s: NP (subject) NP (predicative) 1 I’ve been dying to have some of my favourite sweets, and it’s always nice to get mail!
